queries: WITH inv AS (SELECT invoice_number, AVG(derived_product_cost) AS avg_cost, AVG(derived_total_cost * 1.0 / NULLIF(product_price, 0)) AS ratio FROM Invoice_Line_Items GROUP BY invoice_number HAVING AVG(derived_total_cost * 1.0 / NULLIF(product_price, 0)) IS NOT NULL), overall AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM inv) SELECT AVG(i.avg_cost) AS avg_product_cost, AVG(i.ratio) AS avg_ratio, AVG(i.ratio - o.avg_ratio) AS avg_excess_over_overall FROM inv i CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE i.ratio > o.avg_ratio;

assumptions.assumption: An invoice's ratio is the average over its lines of derived_total_cost / product_price (lines with NULL values or zero price are ignored). Invoices with no computable ratio are excluded from the overall average.

The overall average ratio is the unweighted mean of the per-invoice ratios, and the reported average product cost is the mean of the qualifying invoices' average line costs (not weighted by line count).
The overall average ratio is computed over all invoices with a ratio, and the comparison is strictly greater than it.

alternatives.interpretation: An invoice's ratio is the average total cost divided by the average product price across its lines (AVG(derived_total_cost) / AVG(product_price)), rather than the average of per-line ratios.
alternatives.sql: WITH inv AS (SELECT invoice_number, AVG(derived_product_cost) AS avg_cost, AVG(derived_total_cost) * 1.0 / NULLIF(AVG(product_price), 0) AS ratio FROM Invoice_Line_Items GROUP BY invoice_number HAVING AVG(derived_total_cost) * 1.0 / NULLIF(AVG(product_price), 0) IS NOT NULL), overall AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM inv) SELECT AVG(i.avg_cost) AS avg_product_cost, AVG(i.ratio) AS avg_ratio, AVG(i.ratio - o.avg_ratio) AS avg_excess_over_overall FROM inv i CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE i.ratio > o.avg_ratio;

assumptions.assumption: An invoice's ratio is the average of the per-line ratios derived_total_cost / product_price. Lines with a missing or zero price or a missing total cost are skipped.
The overall average ratio is the unweighted mean of the per-invoice ratios, over invoices that have a non-null ratio.

An invoice's average product cost is the mean of derived_product_cost over its lines, ignoring nulls. The final average product cost is the mean of these per-invoice averages, not a mean over all lines.
Only invoices that have line items are considered.

alternatives.interpretation: An invoice's ratio is the average total cost divided by the average product price across its lines (AVG(total)/AVG(price)), with each average ignoring nulls independently, rather than the average of per-line ratios.
